nodes.name: county_medians
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: county medians per metric and the school year they describe (used as reference lines).
select
    metric_key,
    any_value(county_median) as county_median,
    max(period) filter (where value_status in ('reported','estimate')) as latest_period,
    count(value) as schools_with_value
from {{ ref('fct_school_metrics') }}
group by 1

nodes.name: dim_metrics
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: metric labels and units for the website, with the county median.
select d.metric_key, d.label, d.unit, d.year_group, c.county_median, c.latest_period
from {{ ref('metric_dictionary') }} d
left join {{ ref('county_medians') }} c using (metric_key)
union all
select k, l, 'test points', y, c.county_median, c.latest_period
from (values ('np6', 'National tests, year 6 (maths, Swedish, English)', 6),

nodes.name: fct_metric_history
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: all reported school years for the trend lines (teachers, merit rating, passed all subjects,
-- combined national tests). A series needs at least two years.
with base as (
    select s.school_id, s.metric_key, s.period, s.value
    from {{ ref('stg_statistics') }} s
    join {{ ref('metric_dictionary') }} d using (metric_key)
    where d.keep_history and s.value is not null
),
combined as (
    select school_id, 'np' || right(metric_key, 1) as metric_key, period, round(avg(value), 1) as value
    from base
    where metric_key in ('ma6', 'sv6', 'en6', 'ma9', 'sv9', 'en9')
    group by school_id, right(metric_key, 1), period
    having count(*) >= 2
),
series as (
    select * from base where metric_key in ('teachers', 'merit9', 'pass9')
    union all
    select * from combined
)
select *
from series
qualify count(*) over (partition by school_id, metric_key) >= 2

nodes.name: fct_school_metrics
nodes.description: One row per school and metric: the latest value (with one-year fallback), its school year, status and the county median.
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: one row per school and metric with the value a parent sees.
-- Rule: the latest school year that has values county-wide; if the school has no value that year,
-- fall back one year. Never further. The county median is the median of school values (no ranking).
with stats as (
    select st.* from {{ ref('stg_statistics') }} st
    semi join {{ ref('stg_schools') }} sc using (school_id)
),
latest as (
    select metric_key, max(period) as latest_period
    from stats where value is not null
    group by 1
),
candidates as (
    select s.*, l.latest_period, (s.period = l.latest_period) as is_latest
    from stats s join latest l using (metric_key)
    where s.period = l.latest_period or s.period = {{ prev_period('l.latest_period') }}
),
picked as (
    select *
    from candidates
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by school_id, metric_key
        order by (value is not null) desc, is_latest desc
    ) = 1
),
single as (
    select
        school_id, metric_key,
        value,
        case when value is null then latest_period else period end as period,
        case when value is null then value_status
             when not is_latest then 'reported_previous_year'
             else value_status end as value_status
    from picked
),
-- Combined national test result for year 6 and year 9: mean of maths, Swedish and English
-- when at least two of the three are available.
combined as (
    select
        school_id,
        'np' || right(metric_key, 1)                 as metric_key,
        case when count(value) >= 2 then round(avg(value), 1) end as value,
        coalesce(max(period) filter (where value is not null), max(period)) as period,
        case when count(value) >= 2 then 'reported' else 'not_reported' end as value_status
    from single
    where metric_key in ('ma6', 'sv6', 'en6', 'ma9', 'sv9', 'en9')
    group by school_id, right(metric_key, 1)
),
all_metrics as (
    select * from single
    union all
    select * from combined
),
medians as (
    select metric_key, round(median(value), 1) as county_median, count(value) as schools_with_value
    from all_metrics group by 1
)
select
    a.school_id,
    a.metric_key,
    a.value,
    a.period,
    a.value_status,
    m.county_median,
    case when a.value is null then null
         when a.value > m.county_median then 'above'
         when a.value < m.county_median then 'below'
         else 'equal' end as vs_county
from all_metrics a
join medians m using (metric_key)

nodes.name: school_card
nodes.description: One wide row per school (762). The finder filters and scores these rows in the browser.
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: one wide row per school. This is what the finder filters and scores in the browser.
with m as (
    select
        school_id,
        {% for k in ['teachers','merit9','np6','np9','pass9','pass6','ptr','elig'] %}
        max(value) filter (where metric_key = '{{ k }}')        as {{ k }},
        max(value_status) filter (where metric_key = '{{ k }}') as {{ k }}_status,
        {% endfor %}
        max(period) filter (where metric_key = 'teachers')      as teachers_period
    from {{ ref('fct_school_metrics') }}
    group by 1
),
ap as (
    select school_id,
           list(distinct category order by category) as approach_categories,
           count(*)                                    as approach_codes
    from {{ ref('school_approach') }}
    group by 1
),
green as (
    select school_id, value as green_level, green_pct
    from {{ ref('school_setting') }} where feature = 'green_space_300m'
),
fritids as (
    select school_id, value as fritidshem
    from {{ ref('school_setting') }} where feature = 'fritidshem_registered'
),
happy as (
    select school_id, positive_pct as parents_satisfied_pct
    from {{ ref('school_survey') }}
    where respondent_group = 'parents' and theme_key = 'sat'
)
select
    s.school_id,
    s.school_name,
    s.municipality_name,
    s.address,
    -- Coordinates outside the county are source errors: the school stays in the list, but not on the map.
    case when s.latitude_raw between 58.6 and 60.4 and s.longitude_raw between 17.0 and 19.6 then s.latitude_raw end  as latitude,
    case when s.latitude_raw between 58.6 and 60.4 and s.longitude_raw between 17.0 and 19.6 then s.longitude_raw end as longitude,
    s.organizer_type,
    s.organizer_name,
    s.grades,
    s.grades_label,
    s.website,
    l.review_state,
    coalesce(ap.approach_categories, []::varchar[]) as approach_categories,
    coalesce(ap.approach_codes, 0)                  as approach_codes,
    green.green_level,
    green.green_pct,
    fritids.fritidshem,
    happy.parents_satisfied_pct,
    m.* exclude (school_id)
from {{ ref('stg_schools') }} s
left join {{ ref('stg_review_labels') }} l using (school_id)
left join m using (school_id)
left join ap using (school_id)
left join green using (school_id)
left join fritids using (school_id)
left join happy using (school_id)

nodes.name: school_setting
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: setting features shown on the school page. Green space within 300 m comes from map data;
-- the other features are stated on school websites (with a quote) or taken from the register.
select
    school_id,
    feature,
    value,
    case when feature = 'green_space_300m' then round(numeric_value * 100)::integer end as green_pct,
    quoted_text,
    accessed_date
from {{ ref('stg_school_setting') }}
where feature not in ('forest_300m', 'water_300m', 'green_space_500m')

nodes.name: school_survey
nodes.sql:
-- Gold: survey shares per school, respondent group and theme.
-- Shares are re-based on those who answered (100 - no answer). A theme is dropped when fewer than
-- 30 % answered, or when the shown shares add up to less than 95 % of those who answered
-- (the source prints '-' for small shares, which is only safe to read as 0 when the rest adds up).
with g as (
    select
        school_id, respondent_group, theme_key,
        coalesce(sum(share_pct) filter (where answer_group = 'no_answer'), 0) as no_answer,
        coalesce(sum(share_pct) filter (where answer_group = 'pos'), 0) as pos,
        coalesce(sum(share_pct) filter (where answer_group = 'mid'), 0) as mid,
        coalesce(sum(share_pct) filter (where answer_group = 'neg'), 0) as neg,
        max(answers) as answers
    from {{ ref('stg_survey') }}
    group by all
)
select
    school_id, respondent_group, theme_key,
    round(pos / (pos + mid + neg) * 100)::integer as positive_pct,
    round(mid / (pos + mid + neg) * 100)::integer as middle_pct,
    round(neg / (pos + mid + neg) * 100)::integer as negative_pct,
    answers
from g
where 100 - no_answer >= 30
  and pos + mid + neg >= (100 - no_answer) * 0.95
  and pos + mid + neg > 0

nodes.name: stg_schools
nodes.description: One row per school unit in the county review. No staff names, e-mails or phone numbers.
nodes.sql:
-- Silver: one clean row per school unit in the review (762).
with reg as (
    select
        r.*,
        list_filter(r.addresses, lambda a: a.type = 'BESOKSADRESS')[1] as visit
    from {{ ref('brz_register') }} r
),
grades as (
    select
        school_unit_code,
        list_contains(school_types, 'FKLASS') as has_fklass,
        list_transform(list_filter(gr_grades, lambda g: regexp_matches(g, '^[0-9]+$')), lambda g: cast(g as integer)) as gr_int
    from reg
)
select
    s.school_unit_code                                                as school_id,
    coalesce(r.display_name, r.school_name, s.name)                   as school_name,
    s.municipality_code as municipality_code,
    m.municipality_name,
    trim(both ', ' from coalesce(r.visit.streetAddress, '') || ', ' || coalesce(r.visit.locality, '')) as address,
    try_cast(r.visit.geoCoordinates.latitude as double)               as latitude_raw,
    try_cast(r.visit.geoCoordinates.longitude as double)              as longitude_raw,
    case when r.organizer_type = 'KOMMUN' then 'municipal' else 'independent' end as organizer_type,
    r.organizer_name,
    case when g.has_fklass and len(g.gr_int) > 0 then list_prepend(0, g.gr_int) else g.gr_int end as grades,
    case when len(r.gr_grades) > 0
         then (case when g.has_fklass then 'F' else r.gr_grades[1] end) || '–' || r.gr_grades[-1]
         else '' end                                                  as grades_label,
    coalesce(r.website, s.website)                                    as website,
    s.status                                                          as register_status
from {{ ref('brz_schools') }} s
left join reg r using (school_unit_code)
left join grades g using (school_unit_code)
left join {{ ref('municipalities') }} m on m.municipality_code = s.municipality_code

nodes.name: stg_statistics
nodes.description: Skolverket statistics with a readable value status per value.
nodes.sql:
-- Silver: Skolverket statistics with the source's symbols translated into a value status.
--   '..'   few pupils, value withheld       -> few_pupils
--   '~100' rounded, few pupils not eligible -> rounded
--   '*'    teachers without legitimation    -> teachers_excluded
--   '.' / empty                             -> not_reported
select
    st.school_unit_code                       as school_id,
    st.metric                                 as source_metric,
    d.metric_key,
    st.period,
    st.raw_value,
    st.numeric_value                          as value,
    case
        when st.numeric_value is not null and st.raw_value ilike 'cirka%' then 'estimate'
        when st.numeric_value is not null                                then 'reported'
        when st.value_type = 'OMITTED_DUE_TO_BASED_ON_FEW_PUPILS'         then 'few_pupils'
        when st.value_type like 'ROUNDED%'                                then 'rounded'
        when st.value_type = 'TEACHERS_EXCLUDED_DUE_TO_NO_REQUIRED_LEGITIMATION' then 'teachers_excluded'
        else 'not_reported'
    end                                       as value_status
from {{ ref('brz_statistics') }} st
join {{ ref('metric_dictionary') }} d on d.source_metric = st.metric
where st.period is not null

nodes.name: stg_survey
nodes.sql:
-- Silver: VT26 survey answer shares (percent) for the five themes, grouped into positive / middle / negative.
-- Respondent group is 'parents', or the pupils' year group ('ak5', 'ak8').
select
    o.school_unit_code                                         as school_id,
    case when o.respondent = 'parents' then 'parents' else o.year_group end as respondent_group,
    t.theme_key,
    o.question,
    o.measure,
    g.answer_group,
    o.numeric_value                                            as share_pct,
    o.raw_value,
    try_cast(o.answers_raw as integer)                         as answers
from {{ ref('brz_survey_observations') }} o
join {{ ref('survey_themes') }} t on t.source_metric = o.metric
join {{ ref('survey_answer_groups') }} g on g.measure = o.measure
where o.semester = 'VT26' and o.unit = 'percent'
